verdict.reasoning: Rendered printed page 798 (PDF p820) at 300 dpi. The figure shows: Evaluate condition-1 -> 'Condition-1 true' decision; 'yes' exits right along a line that runs down to the arrow at 'Truth value is true'; 'no' goes down to Evaluate condition-2 -> 'Condition-2 false'; its 'yes' exits LEFT to a vertical line that runs down to the arrow at 'Truth value is false'; its 'no' goes down to Evaluate condition-3 -> 'Condition-3 false'; 'yes' exits left joining the false line, 'no' exits right joining the true line. The claim's description of the PDF is accurate. The markdown (page-820.md) keeps the box labels and the words yes/no but no connectors at all: 'Condition-1 yes\ true' gives no destination for yes, and the two truth values are rendered as a two-column table with no link to any branch. Which outcome each branch produces (the actual content of the figure: OR short-circuits to true on condition-1, AND short-circuits to false on condition-2) cannot be recovered from the markdown. This is a genuine loss of figure content, not reflow or furniture. It is in informative Annex E, so it carries no normative weight.
